prerequisites: None. Competencies taught in the basic modules (topic-dependent) are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students have basic knowledge and skills in a selected sub-area of computer science.
Students know practical concepts and applications in the selected sub-area of computer science.
Students are able to apply scientific working methods to independently solve problems and communicate the solution.
Students have acquired competencies preferably from the field of Artificial Intelligence.

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments
Written exam or oral exam (individual exam)

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two exercise assignments. The grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
